run_search_with_capped_res: run a capped result search of query descriptors against a database using FAISS
run_match_and_make_predictions: run descriptor matching and produce PredictedMatch objects from query and database image descriptors
run_knn_match_and_make_predictions: run k-nearest-neighbor descriptor matching and produce PredictedMatch objects with optional GPU acceleration
run_range_result_read: run a reader that parses binary range search result files into numpy arrays
run_query_iterator: run a batch iterator that yields progressively larger batches of query descriptors
